notes: PENUMBRA — a single-page monochrome exhibition of six generative artworks, all drawn at runtime with Canvas 2D from seeded value-noise and an ordered-dither pass; no image files, no external dependencies, no build step. Each work opens into a dialog with live controls (seed, scale, contrast, invert) and PNG export. Includes a keyboard-operable eleven-value grey scale, a scroll-progress rule, scroll reveals, a permanently fixed difference-blend header, and full prefers-reduced-motion, focus-visible, print and noscript fallbacks. Known limitations: the hero dot field animates only while visible and is capped near 30fps, so lower-power devices may drop frames; the serif and grotesque are system-font stacks, so letterforms shift slightly between platforms; the difference-blend header can lose contrast over mid-grey artwork frames.
